name: Katakamuna ~Ushinawareta Ingaritsu~
original_name: 片神名 ～喪われた因果律～
source:
The story-line follows a high school student who is magically transported from his summer camp to ancient Japan. 
He will need to meet new friends and and solve the mystery of time jump.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述一名高中生从夏令营被魔法传送到古代日本。

他需要结识新的朋友，并解开穿越时空之谜。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
